name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.140.0 — The client player's own chrome is now English-only: the two-language STRINGS table and the lang role are retired from lib/walk-page.js and design-atlas.js's clientRoute, closing an escaped defect where the page declared <html lang="en"> while rendering Japanese chrome. Every save on the player now acts only on the server's answer — a mark hides, the open count drops, a note clears or a reached label counts only once the server responds ok, and any refusal or network failure leaves the page unchanged and reports it in a new [data-wk="msg"] status slot instead of guessing ahead of the network. POST /client/__walk/confirm independently refuses with 409 while any question anchored to the journey's screens is unanswered, so a stale tab or a failed player script can no longer record a client sign-off over an open question. 7.139.0 — ADR-0013 returns the theme pick to /spec:mocks: a new THEME state lands between WALK and CLIENT, where the user authors two or three directions under design/theme/<kebab>/ (tokens re-valuing the wire register's eleven roles), theme shortlist opens a client pick over the seed's two dense screens served in each direction's roles, and the client picks on /client/theme.html. --mark theme-picked adopts the pick with the same discipline theme adopt once had (tokens copied, a confirmed ledger row), and from then on every mock the client walks in the player is served with ?theme=<kebab> — a link swap of the wire register's token file, never a redraw; the session's own atlas and review pages stay neutral. theme open and theme adopt are retired in favor of theme shortlist and --mark theme-picked; a host that already picked at sketch keeps a legacy path with no stop. design-atlas.js check no longer warns on a sketch-status mock still linking wire/ once marks.themePicked is set, and /spec:sketch's Theme step now runs theme state as its normal path, falling back to authoring directions itself only on a host that skipped mocks. 7.138.0 — The build driver's gate now sees the files the build itself created: immediately before spawning the gate child, runGate() adds every untracked, non-ignored File Plan path to the index with intent-to-add (git add -N), so an index-reading host check (a size baseline, a duplication scan, a file manifest) counts a newly created file's real on-disk bytes at build time instead of only after the checkpoint commit made it tracked, at review. The staging is bounded to the spec's own File Plan paths — an out-of-plan creation stays untracked and remains scope-reconcile's finding at commit — and the staged entries are never reverted by the driver, surviving every repair round and the checkpoint commit that consumes them. A File Plan path a host's .gitignore hides is warned about and skipped rather than refused; a failed staging call is a fail-closed refusal (exit 2, no gate child spawned, no gateRuns entry recorded) rather than a gate that ran blind. This is the driver's only index write — every other git call it makes stays a read — and specs/20260901/01-build-driver.md D12's absolute 'never runs a git write' is narrowed accordingly under docs/adr/0015, with spec/commands/build.md's matching Rules clause narrowed in the same build.
